tables.name: audit_logs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `audit_logs` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `employee_no` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(48) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_type` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `detail` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_time` (`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_audit_user` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_action` (`action`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: departments
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `departments` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `parent_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_no` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `kind` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DIVISION',
  `business_parent_scope` bigint(20) unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ifnull(`parent_id`,0)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_departments_parent_kind_name` (`business_parent_scope`,`kind`,`name`),
  KEY `idx_departments_parent` (`parent_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: email_outbox
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `email_outbox` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_type` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `dedupe_key` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `recipient_user_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `recipient_email` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `body` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `retry_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error` varchar(1024) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_outbox_dedupe_key` (`dedupe_key`),
  KEY `idx_outbox_status` (`status`,`retry_count`),
  KEY `idx_outbox_status_next` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`),
  KEY `fk_outbox_project_v2` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_outbox_project_v2` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: files
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `files` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `uploader_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `direction` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `original_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `stored_name` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `ext` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `size_bytes` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `mime_type` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `sha256` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `storage_path` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE',
  `deleted_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `stored_name` (`stored_name`),
  KEY `fk_files_uploader` (`uploader_id`),
  KEY `idx_files_project` (`project_id`),
  KEY `idx_files_status_deleted_at` (`status`,`deleted_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_files_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_files_uploader` FOREIGN KEY (`uploader_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: message_reads
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `message_reads` (
  `message_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `read_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`message_id`,`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_mr_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mr_msg` FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `messages` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mr_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: messages
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `messages` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `sender_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL',
  `deleted_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_msg_sender` (`sender_id`),
  KEY `idx_msg_project_time` (`project_id`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_msg_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_msg_sender` FOREIGN KEY (`sender_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: permissions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `code` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `type` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `parent_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_no` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `code` (`code`),
  KEY `idx_permissions_parent` (`parent_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: project_activities
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `project_activities` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `activity_type` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `actor_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `actor_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `occurred_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `summary` varchar(160) DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_key` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

  KEY `idx_project_activities_project_time` (`project_id`,`occurred_at`,`id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_project_activities_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

tables.name: project_members
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `project_members` (
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`,`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_pm_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pm_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pm_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: project_status_logs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `project_status_logs` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,

  `to_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(16) NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_project_status_logs_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

tables.name: projects
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `projects` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

tables.name: refresh_tokens
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `refresh_tokens` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_rt_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: role_permissions
tables.sql:

tables.name: roles

tables.name: upload_sessions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `upload_sessions` (
  `id` varchar(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `project_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `uploader_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `file_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `file_size` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `file_md5` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `chunk_size` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total_chunks` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `temp_dir` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPLOADING',
  `result_file_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_us_project` (`project_id`),
  KEY `idx_us_uploader` (`uploader_id`),
  KEY `idx_us_status_exp` (`status`,`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_upload_result_file` (`result_file_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_us_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_us_uploader` FOREIGN KEY (`uploader_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: user_roles
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `user_roles` (
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `role_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`role_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_roles_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `fk_ur_role` (`role_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ur_role` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `roles` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ur_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

tables.name: users
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_no` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `real_name` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `user_type` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `supplier_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `must_change_password` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `failed_login_attempts` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `locked_until` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_login_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_login_ip` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_users_employee_no` (`employee_no`),
  KEY `idx_users_supplier` (`supplier_id`),
  KEY `idx_users_department` (`department_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_users_supplier` FOREIGN KEY (`supplier_id`) REFERENCES `suppliers` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
